reasoning_content:
Installation completed. installed.lock exists. Now verify the daemon activation and the app. The systemd path unit should have triggered qisutu-daemon. Our shim: systemctl enable --now "$INSTALL_COMPLETE_PATH" just touches enabled and start_one returns 0 for *.path. So daemon wasn't started automatically. But when we complete install, lock created, but path unit not real. Let's just start the daemon manually per documented behavior, and verify index.pl.

Actually the install.sh for the not-yet-installed case enables the path unit which after lock triggers daemon. Since we don't have real systemd, we can start qisutu-daemon.service manually via the shim. Let's check the daemon service file and try starting it.

First verify the web login page works.

action.command: curl -s -i http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl | head -20; echo "==="; curl -s http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl | grep -oiE "<title>[^<]*</title>"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "curl -s -i http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl | head -20; echo \"===\"; curl -s http://localhost/qisutu/index.pl | grep -oiE \"<title>[^<]*</title>\"", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Verify Qisutu login page"}
